tasks.gr10-business-environments-functions: Topic: Business environments and functions. Cover micro environment, vision, mission, goals, organisational culture, structure, eight business functions, management and leadership. Ask about define-and-explain, scenario-based function identification, structured responses.
tasks.gr10-quality-external-environments: Topic: Quality and external environments. Cover quality, quality control, quality assurance, market environment, macro environment, opportunities, threats. Ask about case studies, quality-indicator matching, environmental links.
